scope: Presentation assets only. No package, permission, install offer or execution qualification is changed.
supersedes: The byte metadata for these three files in docs/SHOWCASE_MEDIA_SOURCES.md describes their earlier versions. This record describes the current distributed originals.

originals.description: High-resolution rendering of the unchanged official Impeccable browser-extension promo SVG template; not a Floe screenshot or execution result.
originals.rendering: The official 440 by 280 SVG template was rendered at device scale 3 with unchanged text and geometry. No bitmap upscaling, redraw or AI generation.

originals.description: Floe-owned AI-assisted concept illustration; source and permission remain as recorded in docs/SHOWCASE_MEDIA_SOURCES.md.
originals.transformation: Lossless PNG IDAT recompression only. Decoded pixels and every non-IDAT metadata chunk are unchanged.

originals.description: Floe-owned AI-assisted concept illustration; source and permission remain as recorded in docs/SHOWCASE_MEDIA_SOURCES.md.
originals.transformation: Lossless PNG IDAT recompression only. Decoded pixels and every non-IDAT metadata chunk are unchanged.

derivatives.transformation: Proportionally resized and encoded as WebP without enlargement. Each derivative inherits the source image attribution and license; it has no independent App screenshot or execution claim.
derivatives.identity: Read the manifest, source Git blobs and derivative files from the same immutable publication commit. Validate source bindings and derivative bytes; the manifest cannot grant permissions or install eligibility.
